column1: # THE Q0 DETECTOR VERSUS THE CORRECTION DETECTOR.
# qualification01-verify.HC) is NOT modified and NOT overwritten.
# Its source is read from the predecessor close tree. Parity for
# the correction is established in the NEW correction detector
# A HISTORICAL Q0 CAPABILITY CANNOT BE BACKDATED BY A
# CORRECTION. Where the correction requires a reason token that
# the Q0 detector does not emit, the discrepancy is DISCLOSED in
# the historical_discrepancy column rather than papered over.
# THE TWO ROSTERS ARE DISJOINT BY DESIGN.
#   The Q0 roster (NC01..NC24) names the PREDECESSOR defects.
#   The correction roster (NC-C01..NC-C18) names the CORRECTION
#   defects: the frozen-contract drift, the evidence binding, the
#   count reconciliation, the route-scoped ownership and the
#   A token supported by one roster is NOT thereby supported by
#   the other. Rows are therefore emitted for BOTH rosters and
#   the cross-roster column records the DISCLOSED GAP.
#   q0_detector_supported         the exact reason token appears
#                                 WHOLE in the Q0 detector SOURCE.
#   correction_detector_supported the exact reason token appears
